item.title: Assam Commissions Northeast India’s First Large-Scale 70 MW Solar Plant on APDCL Land
item.description: Assam has operationalised SJVN’s first large-scale solar project in the state, marking the company’s first operational project in the North Eastern Region. Assam Chief Minister (CM) Himanta Biswa Sarma inaugurated the 70 MW Dhubri Solar Power Project of SJVN Green Energy Limited (SGEL) on 330 acres of land provided by the Assam Power Distribution Company Limited (APDCL). item.title: SECI Crosses 25 GW Commissioned Solar Capacity, Including VGF Scheme
item.description: Solar Energy Corporation of India (SECI) has now commissioned more than 25 GW of solar projects under various government schemes, including the Viability Gap Funding (VGF) scheme. The company said in a social media post that these projects were awarded under the Standard Bidding Guidelines (SBG), including solar projects linked with Solar Manufacturing, the Central Public Sector Undertaking (CPSU) Scheme, and other miscellaneous categories. item.title: Bihar Eyes Free Electricity Through Rooftop Solar, Invites Bids Under RESCO
item.description: The Bihar government is aiming to provide free electricity of up to 125 units per month to domestic consumers by rolling out a large-scale rooftop solar programme. To achieve this, state agencies plan to install small rooftop solar power plants at households across the state at no upfront cost to consumers, with projects to be implemented under the RESCO model. item.title: Altris, Draslovka to Build Europe’s First Industrial-Scale Sodium-ion Battery Supply Chain
item.description: Swedish sodium-ion battery developer Altris and Draslovka, a global leader in specialty chemicals, have partnered to build one of Europe’s first industrial-scale sodium-ion cathode value chains. According to a press release, the agreement includes a total in-kind investment of 19.3 m EUR by Draslovka in Altris. item.description: Insolation Green Energy, a subsidiary of Insolation Energy, has entered into a Memorandum of Understanding (MoU) with Bondada Engineering to supply solar modules under ALMM-1 and ALMM-II (Make in India Solar Cell and Solar Module). item.title: NVVN To Solarise Premises of BEML With Rooftop Solar, Issues Tender
item.description: NTPC Vidyut Vyapar Nigam Limited (NVVN) has planned to solarise the premises of BEML Limited, a Government of India–owned public sector undertaking engaged in the manufacture of heavy equipment for the defence, mining, rail and metro, and construction sectors. item.title: Punjab Govt Releases Tender For 500 MW of Standalone BESS
item.description: Punjab State Electricity Board (PSEB) has now issued a tender to set up 500 megawatts (MW) / 1,000 megawatt-hours (MWh) of standalone battery energy storage systems (BESS) in the northern state of Punjab, according to tender documents. item.title: Ddev Plastiks Industries Ventures into BESS Segment with ₹150–200 Cr Investment
item.description: Ddev Plastiks Industries’ Board of Directors, at its latest meeting, approved a proposal to venture into the Battery Energy Storage System (BESS) business within the renewable energy sector. Ddev Plastiks Industries said in a regulatory filing that it plans to invest approximately Rs. 150–200 crore in Phase 1.
